v7bsk56v.sourceDescription: Our most popular pre-lit Christmas tree, the 9ft Ultra Devonshire Fir tree combines stunning realism with a wonderful lighting display. There's no need to untangle any Christmas lights yourself with this one. Just click the button on the controller box to soften your tree with a warm white or go kaleidoscopic with the multicoloured option - the lighting choice is all yours! There are 8 different lighting functions, including the classic 'always on' as well as the unique flashing function that effortlessly mixes both colours together. Picture shows 7ft tree in our range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included. 1hm8wmgh.baseName: Walplus 160 LED Lights Pre-lit Swirl Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 180 cm
1hm8wmgh.variantName: Walplus 160 LED Lights Pre-lit Swirl Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 180 cm
1hm8wmgh.sourceDescription: Create an extraordinary magical holiday ambience in your house with this swirl pre-lit Christmas tree! Swirl design: The artificial tree features a unique swirl design, making it an eye-catching centrepiece of your Christmas decorations.LED lights: The Xmas tree lights up beautifully and is decorated with multiple energy-efficient LED lights, creating a cosy holiday atmosphere.Different lighting effects: The LEDs are designed with 8 different lighting effects: a combination of all the effects, slow-glow, twinkle/flash, in wave, chasing/running water, sequential, steady on and slow fade.PVC tips: This Christmas decoration includes multiple PVC tips, which provide a stunningly realistic look to the tree and give it a very bushy appearance too.Stable stand: The bottom stand provides the Christmas tree with optimal stability. Note:The product has a USB connector, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Product Specifications Colour: White LED colour: Warm white Material: PVC, steel Total height: 180 cm Bottom width: 95 cm Stand width: 40 cm Number of LEDs: 160 Power source: USB Power cable length: 2 m With USB With 720 tips With 8 light effects Assembly required: Yes Delivery contains: 1 x Christmas tree 1 x Stand This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
